nodes.label: The Avengers: Collective Intelligence of Smaller LMs
nodes.rationale: Proposes training-free framework combining 10 ~7B models via embedding, clustering, scoring, and voting to match/exceed GPT-4.1 performance across 15 diverse benchmarks.

nodes.label: Clustering-Based Query Routing
nodes.rationale: Core mechanism: embeds queries, clusters them semantically, builds cluster-wise capability profiles for each model, routes test queries to best-performing models in their cluster.

nodes.label: Automatic Model Set Construction
nodes.rationale: Selects complementary models from candidate pool by ranking based on cluster-wise performance, balancing specialization and diversity.

nodes.label: 15 Diverse Benchmarks (Math, Code, Logic, Knowledge, Affective)
nodes.rationale: Evaluation across AIME, MATH500, LiveMathBench, MBPP, HumanEval, KORBench, BBH, ARC, MMLUPro, GPQA, FinQA, MedQA, EmoryNLP, MELD.

nodes.label: Contrastive Learning and Self-Consistency
nodes.rationale: Self-Consistency (SC) strategy: sample multiple responses and take majority vote. Model-Switch extends SC to multiple models. Used for improving reasoning in LLMs.

nodes.label: Router-Based Multi-Model Ensemble Methods
nodes.rationale: Select best model(s) for each query via trained or training-free routing. Avengers uses training-free clustering-based routing vs. RouterDC, EmbedLLM, MODEL-SAT which require neural network training.

nodes.label: Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) Methods
nodes.rationale: Multiple models generate responses in parallel, aggregated via hierarchical layers. Effective for large models but struggles with smaller models due to instruction-following limitations.

hyperedges.label: Multi-Model Ensemble for LLM Reasoning
hyperedges.rationale: Avengers framework combines training-free clustering-based routing with self-consistency voting to leverage collective intelligence of smaller models. Contrasts with trained routers and mixture methods.
